result.title: The Cambist and Lord Iron: A Fairy Tale of Economics

contents.markdown: Available in PDF [here](http://www.freesfonline.de/content/Abraham1.pdf), the short story in question may appeal to LW readers for its approach of viewing more things than are customary in handy economic terms, and is a fine piece of fiction to boot. The moneychanger protagonist gets out of several sticky situations by [making desperate efforts](/lw/uo/make_an_extraordinary_effort/), deploying the concepts of markets, revealed preferences, and wealth generation as he goes.
